waypoints.name: Lupine Meadows Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Moose Junction on US-26/89/191, turn west onto the Teton Park Road, pass the Moose entrance station, and drive north a little over 7 miles to the Lupine Meadows Road on the left, just south of Jenny Lake. Follow the gravel road to its end at the Lupine Meadows parking area. A Grand Teton National Park entrance pass is required.

waypoints.name: Teewinot Mountain
waypoints.directions: Take the unsigned climbers' trail from the north end of the lot straight toward Teewinot, then up many steep switchbacks to the Apex near timberline. Continue up the ridge past the Idol and Worshipper towers on your left to the big east face snowfield, climb it, then scramble 3rd-class slabs and traverse left into the V-shaped gully; its 4th-class crux leads to the summit.
